'''Warehouse #52''' was located in [[Nargo (city)|Nargo]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nigel VI]]. There, a group of adventurers went to pick up a shipment of "[[Spice/Legends|spice]]." When they arrived, a group of [[Warehouse bandits|bandits]] were trying to steal the cargo. After chasing off the bandits, the adventurers realized the cargo was actually [[lexonite]], a deadly [[Poison/Legends|poison]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] groups.<ref name="P" />
